faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Audio Video Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Audio Video Officer (Grade 2) - Technical post is 26th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Audio Video Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Audio Video Officer (Grade 2) - Technical position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have Higher Secondary (10+2) with 55% marks and 15 years of experience, or a Bachelor's Degree with 55% marks and 12 years of experience, along with Advanced Multimedia certification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Audio Video Officer (Grade 2) - Technical post is 55 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it along with required documents to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Audio Video Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Audio Video Officer (Grade 2) - Technical post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Audio Video Officer (Grade 2) - Technical position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIT Kharagpur. Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section.
